Jack Lawless | Jack Lawless (born September 20, 1987) is an American musician and drummer.  He is best known as the drummer for the popular pop rock band the Jonas Brothers.  He is also the drummer of Ocean Grove, and of DNCE.  He grew up in Middletown Township, New Jersey, part of Monmouth County.

Paul Bultitude | Paul Bultitude is an English musician and record producer. The group was headed by Carol Lou Hedges (born May 20, 1931, Peru, Indiana), whose modest demeanor belied her piano virtuosity and swinging style.  Husband and bassist John Hedges was the other permanent member of the group, with various drummers having been employed, including future drummer for the Count Basie band and Tony Bennett, Harold Jones (drummer) in 1956-57.  The trio's reputation spread mostly by word of mouth, but it did release several singles and one album.
Photo-Finish | Photo-Finish is the ninth album by Irish musician Rory Gallagher, released in 1978.  It marked a turning point in Gallagher's career.  Most of the songs on "Photo-Finish" were initially recorded on what was to be an earlier album called "Torch" but Gallagher was unhappy with the recordings.  He fired the drummer and keyboardist from his current band and replaced only the drummer changing the band to a power trio as his original bands had been.
